description: The A1 sealed English retrieval probe (council amendment, issue 1511): 40 items of natural English whose names, places and numbers lie outside every syllable, v1 and v2 pool and whose phrasings match no v2 template. Never trained on: corpora exclude any conversation that shares an 8-word user-turn n-gram with it. The last turn of every item is the scored turn; its checks are derived from its typed fields (answer and stale for recall, copy for exact copying) with the same Check2 machinery the M-world v2 oracle uses. The file is authored data pinned by SHA-256 in milestone_world_v2_probe.rs.
